common_app_specs.ferpa_waiver_advice: Waive FERPA access to letters of recommendation; irreversible after first submission.
common_app_specs.verify_note: Re-verify Common App prompts and word limits after the August 1, 2027 rollover.

milestones.title: Finalize Senior-Year Course Rigor & 2026 PPY Tax Check
milestones.details: Lock senior AP/IB/DE courses aligned to target major; review 2026 tax year impact on Fall 2028 financial aid.

milestones.title: Ask 2 Junior Teachers for LORs & Submit Brag Sheets
milestones.details: Request 1 STEM + 1 Humanities junior-year teacher; submit student & parent brag sheets via Naviance/Scoir.

milestones.title: Common App Opens / Rollover (2027-2028 Cycle)
milestones.details: Create/roll over Common App account; confirm supplemental prompts and 300w/250w writing limits; waive FERPA.

milestones.title: FAFSA, CSS Profile & UC Application Window Open
milestones.details: Eligible citizens/GC holders file FAFSA; H-4/F-1/private-school applicants file CSS Profile / ISFAA and prepare IDOC.

milestones.title: Internal High School Transcript & LOR Request Deadline
milestones.details: Submit Naviance/Scoir requests 3-4 weeks before Nov 1 college deadlines.

milestones.title: EA / REA / ED I & Priority Merit / Honors Deadlines
milestones.details: Submit Early Action, Restrictive EA, binding ED I, Honors, and priority merit apps; activate portals within 72 hours and clear TOEFL waivers.

milestones.title: UC Application Submission Deadline
milestones.details: Final day for University of California campuses (separate portal from Common App).

milestones.title: Competitive Merit Scholarship Priority Deadlines
milestones.details: Final priority window for major merit awards at select public/private universities.

milestones.title: Regular Decision (RD) & ED II Deadlines (Jan 1 - Jan 15)
milestones.details: Submit RD/ED II apps, CSS Profile/ISFAA/IDOC docs, and opt in to alumni interviews.

milestones.title: Mid-Year Transcripts & Deferral LOCIs
milestones.details: Ensure counselor submits mid-year report; send concise LOCI for deferred apps only where permitted.

milestones.title: Compare Financial Aid Awards & File Appeals
milestones.details: Normalize grants vs. loans/work-study; submit special-circumstance or merit appeals before May 1.

milestones.title: National College Decision Day (Single Enrollment Deposit)
milestones.details: Submit one enrollment deposit (never double-deposit); F-1 students submit Certificate of Finances for Form I-20.
